faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Jodhpur (IIT Jodhpur) for filling up contractual positions.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised by IIT Jodhpur?
faq.answer: IIT Jodhpur has advertised the post of Scientific Officer (Veterinary) under advertisement number IITJ/OR(NF)/2026-27/66.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Scientific Officer (Veterinary) post on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master’s Degree in Veterinary along with 05 years of relevant experience in the specialized area.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit to apply for IIT Jodhpur Scientific Officer?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 40 years as per the official recruitment notification guidelines.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Scientific Officer (Veterinary) post will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 1,15,000/- to 1,30,000/-.

faq.question: Q7. When does the application process start and end?
faq.answer: The online application process starts on 01-10-2026 and the last date to submit the completed application form is 21-10-2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to submit their applications through online mode only by visiting the official IIT Jodhpur application portal.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for IIT Jodhpur Scientific Officer?
faq.answer: The selection process typically includes shortlisting based on specific criteria, followed by a test or interview and document verification.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I apply for this job opening?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply directly through the online application portal available on the official website https://iitj.ac.in.
